Players Committee card image of [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) (V) (Errata 3)]] (errata PC-E3), game text: “While aboard a starfighter, adds 2 to power, maneuver, and hyperspeed. While present with a Scomp link, adds one [Light Side] icon here. Immune to Fire Extinguisher and Restraining Bolt.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/r2d2.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/32fe4eb44d05730d9552d4b4a1865040f8e5b0bf 32fe4eb] (27 November 2021). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
